According to Article 12(4) of the Common Reporting Standard Law and Article 18(2)(b) of the General Partnership Law, what are the retention periods for records?
references.answer: Under the CRS Law, records must be retained for 6 years after reporting. Under the General Partnership Law, accounting records must be preserved for at least 6 years from creation, or longer if prescribed by Regulations.
